title: A hard cluster hides soft membership
hook: Two stated cases: explore the posterior membership under equal-variance Gaussian classes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the posterior membership under equal-variance Gaussian classes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines PosteriorA, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the posterior membership under equal-variance Gaussian classes in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Soft membership weighs densities and priors. A hard nearest-center label discards this uncertainty and may ignore unequal class priors. This comparison isolates the posterior membership under equal-variance Gaussian classes.
